args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but actually
quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
tests/test_money.py passes (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66, not 2.67).

args.body:
## Summary
- Fixed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding), as required by FIN-212.
- The function's docstring already claimed banker's rounding, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).
args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding per FIN-212, so `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` and committed a one-line change to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` — it passed.
- **PR:** Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with alex requested as reviewer.

Per policy, I did not merge — that's awaiting alex's review/approval.
